Common questions

How is my body-fat estimate worked out?

From the tape measurements you enter — waist, neck, height, weight and, for women, hips — using the published US Navy circumference formulas. It is an estimate, not a clinical measurement, and it is not medical advice. Nothing is guessed from your photos, and no AI service is involved.

Do I have to add a photo?

No. Progress photos are entirely optional and the app works fully without one. A photo you do add is private: it is never shown to anyone else, never analysed, and never used for advertising or to train any model.

Why can I only take one assessment a week?

Body composition does not move meaningfully day to day, and measuring more often mostly measures noise — water, food and time of day. A new assessment unlocks seven days after the last one.

Symmetry shows "—" instead of a number

That means no limb measurements were entered for that assessment. GetFit shows a dash rather than inventing a figure. Add left and right arm and thigh measurements and the next assessment will carry a real score.

Membership

What does a membership include?

Personalised workouts, progressive overload, guided sessions, weekly body analysis, and progress and goal tracking.

How do I cancel?

Your subscription belongs to Apple, not to us, so it is cancelled in your device settings:

Settings → your name → Subscriptions → GetFit → Cancel Subscription

You keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for. Deleting your GetFit account does not cancel the subscription — cancel it first.

I paid but the app still shows the paywall

Tap Restore purchase on the membership screen. That asks Apple directly what you own. If it still does not unlock, email us with the date of purchase and we will sort it out.

Refunds

Apple handles all refunds for purchases made in the App Store. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds ourselves.

Your data

How do I delete everything?

Settings → Privacy & data → Delete account. That removes your measurements, assessments, photos and training history. It is immediate and cannot be undone.

What do you collect, exactly?

See the Privacy Policy. The short version: your measurements and training history, your email address, and any photo you chose to add. No tracking, no advertising, and nothing sent to any AI service.

Health and safety

GetFit is a fitness tool, not a medical device, and nothing it produces is medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new training programme, particularly if you have an injury, a heart condition, or are pregnant. Stop exercising and seek medical help if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath.
